narrative.summary: Not a protocol consuming an oracle - the oracle’s own governance. One Safe is owner() on every Chainlink feed sampled on this chain, including 3 already-tracked stock-token feeds.
narrative.detail: owner() was called live on 7 independently-sampled Chainlink aggregator proxies - the Robinhood TSLA/AMZN/AMD stock feeds already tracked above, plus LINK/USD, ETH/USD and USDG/USD - and all 7 resolve to the identical address, confirmed a real 4-of-9 Gnosis Safe. Chainlink is the only officially confirmed price-oracle provider on this chain (57 feeds in Chainlink’s own dataset); every protocol here that reads a Chainlink price, tracked by this oracle or not, inherits whatever controls this one Safe. No timelock layer was identified above it this pass - absence of evidence isn’t scored as evidence of one.
